skills.name: 想像×創造＝∞

skills.name: 光れ！弾けろ！超新星爆発！

skills.name: Ring-a-Link

skills.name: エパヌイスマンの大号令

skills.name: 冠絶タクティクス

skills.name: Dazzl'n ♪ Diver

skills.desc: Recover endurance by relaxing after activating 2 skills when positioned midpack mid-race.

skills.name: Ahead of the Horizon
skills.desc: Moderately surge ahead when leading at the start of late-race. If it's on the third corner and the skill user led by a large margin mid-race, greatly surge ahead instead.

skills.name: Certain Victory
skills.desc: Greatly increase velocity with an indomitable fighting spirit on the final straight after being on the heels of another runner toward the front on the final corner or later.

skills.name: A Kiss for Courage
skills.desc: Increase velocity enthusiastically when positioned toward the front in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with a skill.

skills.name: Ravissant

skills.name: Festive Miracle

skills.name: 564 Escapades

skills.name: Into High Gear!
skills.desc: If positioned midpack on a downhill mid-race or later, increase velocity for a moderate duration after the downhill. If it's at Tokyo Racecourse, also kick into high gear.

skills.name: Queen's Lumination
skills.desc: Moderately increase velocity continuously when toward the front on a straight in the second half of the race. Effect increases if leading and close to the runner behind.

skills.name: Superior Heal

skills.name: First Bite of the Feast!

skills.name: Legacy of the Strong
skills.desc: Increase velocity continuously when pressured toward the front late-race on the final corner or later.

skills.name: Condor's Fury
skills.desc: Increase acceleration with blazing passion when aiming for the front from midpack on the final corner.

skills.name: Barcarole of Blessings
skills.desc: Increase velocity when positioned in the front part of the pack with 400m remaining. If the skill user has activated at least 7 skills, increase velocity greatly instead.

skills.name: Free from the Ashes
skills.desc: Increase velocity when in the front part of the pack on the latter half of the final corner late-race. If the race is long and the user engaged in a challenge mid-race, massively increase instead.

skills.name: Arrows Whistle, Shadows Disperse
skills.nameJp: 翳り退く、さざめきの矢
skills.desc: Burning spirit increases velocity continuously on the last corner and later when pressured while in the front of the pack late-race.

skills.name: Eternal Moments

skills.name: THE MOE AAAA Thanks for My Life

skills.name: Break It Down!

skills.name: Best Day Ever

skills.name: Flowery☆Maneuver

skills.name: 心からのおもてにゃし

skills.name: Racing Spirit: Wit
skills.desc: Slightly increase velocity upon activating 2 skills during the second half of the race.

skills.name: Racing Spirit: Mood
skills.desc: Stamina, Guts, and Wit might moderately increase when mood is good or great.

skills.desc: 終盤以降の最終直線で中団以前だと速度が上がる、さらに「聖女の試練」で速度が上がっているならわずかに前に出る＜作戦・差し＞

skills.name: 天与の恩寵
skills.desc: いずれかの下り坂のどこかで加速力が少し上がる、さらに「聖女の試練」で速度が上がっているなら持久力を少し使って少し前に出る＜作戦・差し＞

skills.name: ブラッシュアップ！
skills.desc: レース中盤が迫ったどこかでしばらくの間速度が上がる、「大逃げ」が発動していると効果が変わり、持久力を少し回復して速度が少し上がる＜作戦・逃げ＞

skills.name: 緊急重版
skills.desc: 2000m以上のレースならレース終盤始めの早めのどこかで前方だと加速力が上がる、さらにスキル発動時2番手以内だと少し前に出る＜作戦・逃げ＞

skills.name: 星奔光天
skills.desc: レース終盤が迫ったどこかで前方だと速度が上がる、2000m以上のレースならその後最終直線で先団だと少し前に出る＜先行・芝＞

skills.name: 天意の彼方
skills.desc: レース中盤始めのどこかで前方だと速度が少し上がる、その後最終コーナー前の第3コーナーのどこかで少し前に出る＜先行・中距離＞

skills.name: 久遠の天際
skills.desc: レース中盤始めのどこかで前方だと速度がすごく上がり持久力を回復する＜先行・長距離＞

skills.name: Chain of Hearts
skills.desc: レース中盤の直線のどこかで中団以降だとしばらくの間少し前に出る、その後終盤以降の最終直線で中団だと速度がわずかに上がる＜作戦・差し＞

skills.name: 暗夜の灯
skills.desc: 最終コーナー前の第3コーナーのどこかで前に出る、さらに中距離レースなら加速力がわずかに上がる＜中距離/長距離＞

skills.name: Impeccable
skills.desc: 最終コーナー前の第3コーナーのどこかで前方だと前に出て加速力がちょっと上がる、2400mならその後最終盤でわずかに前に出る＜マイル/中距離＞

skills.name: Rose of Steel
skills.desc: レース中盤のどこかで前方だと速度がすごく上がる＜作戦・先行＞

skills.name: 巧妙なるギャンビット
skills.nameJp: 巧妙なるギャンビット
skills.desc: 2000m～2500mのレースなら出遅れる時間が長くなるその後レース中盤始めのどこかでしばらくの間速度がすごく上がる＜芝＞

skills.name: 強襲トリック
skills.desc: 2000m～2500mのレースなら終盤始めの早めのどこかで加速力がすごく上がるさらに中距離でレース後半に追い抜いているなら少し前に出る＜先行/追込＞

skills.name: 妙技・坂落とし
skills.desc: いずれかの下り坂のどこかですごく前に出るさらにマイルか中距離レースなら加速力がわずかに上がる＜先行/差し＞

skills.name: 寄らば斬る！
